verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own llms.txt states it provides an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client and OSS server. The public GitHub repository can be cloned and shows source modules such as libs/clipboard. A community user independently describes reading the code. missing for 10: license confirmation from the repository itself (only llms.txt states AGPL), and Server Pro features are commercial rather than open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
